articles.title: Asian Games’ bed crunch: Japan says ‘more than expected’ athletes caused trouble

Athletes experienced significant transport issues, including long waits at the airport and inadequate bus services. Several sports saw poor attendance, including the opening ceremony, which had many empty seats.
